items.synopsis: Port-mirroring is not working if hierarchical-scheduler is enabled on the analyzer output port
items.description: On ACX7100 platform, the mirrored packets are not sent thru the output inteface if the "hierarchical-scheduler" is configured under the output interface.

items.synopsis: Some VPLS and L2VPN streams are dropped on the AE interface after a change in MTU configuration on the AE interface
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms the MTU change on the LAG interface triggers an interface flap leading to ECMP next-hop modification. When this issue happens some of the Layer 2 Virtual Private Network (L2VPN) and Virtual Private LAN Services (VPLS) flows may get dropped. The issue is not observed consistently.

items.synopsis: The fibd process will crash when a large number of interfaces are deleted and added back
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, fibd process will crash when a large number of logical interfaces (> 1K) are deleted and added back in a single commit or multiple commits in a very less time (<5 seconds). When fibd crashes, Forwarding Information Base (FIB) will restart and function as normal.

items.category: Issues related to evo operations - libevo infra, typeinfo ..
items.synopsis: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, the traffic impact is seen as the "set system process routing enable/disable" knob is not working as expected
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, if the routing is stopped using "set system process routing disable" and commit, the routing process will not come online once "delete system process routing disable" and commit is done.

items.category: Issues related to Junos licensing infrastructure
items.synopsis: The license might get out of sync between master and backup RE
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, the license might get out of sync between master and backup RE after the addition/deletion of licenses.

items.category: Issues related to Junos licensing infrastructure
items.synopsis: License key is not installed after upgrade
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, Installation of node-lock license key on config mode doesn't get installed after upgrade. If any of the protocols are enabled by the license key, it will be impacted after the software upgrade.

items.synopsis: An rpd crash is observed while creating indirect-next-hop in the BGP sharding environment with bgp.l3vpn.0 with next-shop as a color route
items.description: On Junos MX and Junos Evolved PTX platforms with BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) sharding enabled, an rpd crash is observed for indirect-next-hop is not created properly for the tunnel route when the route is received in the sharding thread in bgp.l3vpn.0 with next-hop as the color route.

items.synopsis: The TWAMP test session packets are dropped when the payload is less than 52 bytes
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platform and Junos platform is using MPC10E/MPC11E/JNP10K-LC9600 linecards, If a Two-Way Active Management Protocol (TWAMP) client from a different vendor is transmitting a packet that is smaller than the 52 bytes then (the minimum allowed by RFC5357 is 41), the TWAMP reflector will be unable to function. Any packets from the TWAMP client will therefore be ignored. Similar to this, juniper boxes will also block any answers that are less than 52 bytes long, causing TWAMP test sessions to report a packet loss.

items.category: EVO L3 routing for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: QFX5220-32CD: evo-pfemand core is seen after ISSU upgrade via automated script.
items.description: On QFX5220-32CD, evo-pfemand core is seen after ISSU upgrade via automated script. In this scenario, evo-pfemand restarts and service is resumed. There will be impact to traffic until evo-pfemand initialisation completes.

items.category: Gnats category for dynamic rendering infrastructure
items.synopsis: The routing protocol daemon may core dump when streaming telemetry data
items.description: There are edge cases where the routing protocol daemon may core dump when streaming the telemetry data for paths under the protocol container. For example: "/network-instances/network-instance[name='DEFAULT']/protocols/protocol/isis"

items.category: System Management daemon and related issues
items.synopsis: Sapphire :: Qfx5220-128c: System reboot related log message SYSTEM_REBOOT_EVENT may not be displayed in 'show log messages' | match SYSTEM_REBOOT_EVENT.
items.description: On a QFX5220 system, system reboot from cli, log related to system reboot event may not appear in message log or cli> show log messages | match SYSTEM_REBOOT_EVENT. Users can see the log in journalctl logs.

items.synopsis: RPD core is seen after the switchover
items.description: On all dual-RE Junos Evolved platforms, RPD core will be seen in the new master RE after the switchover when NSR is enabled. This issue will be seen when before the switchover, any catastrophic configuration change like 'evpn protocol normalization' is done.

items.synopsis: In the EVPN-MPLS multihoming scenario, MAC-IP route deletion and addition result in traffic drop
items.description: On all platforms, MAC-IP route deletion and addition are triggered when re-ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) on MH (Multihoming) device fails in the EVPN-MPLS multihoming scenario resulting in traffic drop.

items.synopsis: JDI_REG:: EVO:Scapa[BFD]: one of the BFD state is down after Performing BT Restart"
items.description: This issue is seen during CLI triggered onlining of the PFE, i.e., when "request chassis fpc slot pfe restart" is executed. Please use the workaround provided.

items.synopsis: Test Configuration might fail even though the config file is having valid configurations
items.description: Root cause; In test configuration flow we are calling mustd as "/usr/sbin/mustd -q /var/run/db/file.data /var/run/db/file.data+ -F -m" where we just copy the existing cog.db (generated out of committed config) as cdg.db+ , use it for testing the configuration passed, and remove it once the testing is done. This is creating the issue because the configuration is tested against the existing cdg.db. Fix would be to create the cdg.db fresh from the configuration to be tested and test the configuration against that. This new cdg.db should not replace the existing one in /var/run/db.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: Configuration filtering doesn't work when the logical system is present
items.description: On SRX platforms, configuration filtering doesn't work when the logical system is present.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The mgd process might crash during commit synchronize
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with dual Routing Engines, during commit script synchronize, the backup Routing Engine mgd get process crashes once the memory leak reaches 65K. When this happens, commit configurations from the primary Routing Engine fail.

items.synopsis: Performance Monitoring for 400ZR optics reporting data as Suspect with reason "Int Too Short"
items.description: For ACX7100-32C and ACX7100-48C platforms, increase the Performance Monitoring (PM) Engine polling interval from one every 2 and 4 seconds, respectively, to 1 per second for both platforms.
